implementation: Nightseam v0.6.0 at 5cc9723a24646c40ed1861f892b2b23eb6d785d7: public At/at, Mount/mount, ForwardWire/forwardWire, local pairs and WebSocket peers

gaps.requirement: ADR0006: compose(origin, children) admits a composite whose own value is not the refusing origin.
gaps.evidence: The release has no public constructor taking an origin. Mount/mount is the child-only specialization: it takes only children and refuses []. https://github.com/Bitspark/nightseam/blob/5cc9723a24646c40ed1861f892b2b23eb6d785d7/duplex/go/wire.go#L140-L150 https://github.com/Bitspark/nightseam/blob/5cc9723a24646c40ed1861f892b2b23eb6d785d7/duplex/ts/src/wire.ts#L91-L96

gaps.requirement: ADR0006: construction refuses conflicting child segments before a native map can discard one.
gaps.evidence: Mount/mount accepts only an already-built native map. The later entry replaced the earlier one before Mount ran, so ["a"] reached the replacing child and the retained description no longer matches the routes.

gaps.requirement: ADR0006: construction refuses a segment outside the exact UTF-8 key image.
gaps.evidence: Mount/mount copies the key without validation. The child becomes unreachable because sending validates the path later (ErrPath / invalid_path).

gaps.requirement: ADR0006: every child is complete Wire access; construction refuses a missing child value.
gaps.evidence: Mount/mount accepts a nil (Go) or undefined (TypeScript) child and later refuses sends to that key as missing (ErrNoRoute / no_route).

limitations.requirement: ADR0006: a child is complete send access; composition requires no receive attachment or closure authority from it.
limitations.evidence: Mount/mount types its children as Endpoint. The production driver adapts send-only children (instrumented access, guards, selected views) with a receive attachment that refuses and a Close that owns nothing. Mount then works for sending; its receiving mode would refuse such a child.

limitations.requirement: ADR0006: the construction owner retains Parts; send access reveals none.
limitations.evidence: Mount/mount exposes no parts. The production driver retains the entries it supplied, which ADR0006 permits. Clearing the supplied map after construction left routing unchanged, so Mount copies its input.
